fn tint_panel(cx: &App) -> impl IntoElement {
    div()
        .size_full()
        .child(
            div()
                .absolute()
                .inset_0()
                .rounded(decoration::frame_radius(cx))
                .bg(cx.theme().background.opacity(0.55)),
        )
        .child(edge_light(cx))
}
